verdict.rationale: Runway's own docs describe Aleph 2.0 as a precise video editing model and position the product as an AI video editor that edits real footage with generative models. A hands-on community report says its masking adapted near-seamlessly to changing poses, which supports isolating an element within a frame. However, no documentation explicitly describes replacing or restyling a specific element while preserving the rest of the frame. missing for 10: explicit documentation of element replacement/restyling in existing video, evidence that untouched regions stay intact, independent hands-on corroboration of element replacement (as opposed to masking).

support.subject: As a creator, I can replace or restyle an element inside an existing video while the rest of the frame stays intact
